test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Which of the following facts is mentioned in the given passage?**

options.text: Sunflower seeds have no other use except for making oil.
Oil from sunflower seeds is only meant for human consumption.
The sunflower’s leaves, flowers and seeds have many uses.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The sunflower’s leaves, flowers and seeds have many uses.**
